## This work (Р-221)

Each unit is one scenario with its own registered book (English original, text layer): `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show <book_id> <page>` and `pages.py image` for page images; the page map may have found few or no printed numbers — find the printed/physical relation on the page images and report it (the lead sets `offset`). Every number comes from the English page. Russian text and names: the owner's translation in `C:\_Hobby\Yandex.Disk\НРИ\1_Зов Ктулху\2_Обработка\<folder>` (named in your unit; the owner ranks above our translation; where it differs from the original in facts, follow the original and note it); official forms of known Mythos names — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (they win over the owner's spelling; his form goes to `aliases` through a proposal). Flag `translated`. Run tools as `python -B …`.

- **Edition check first:** if the original is not written for 7th edition (6e numbers: no percentages for characteristics, Resistance Table, SAN like «1/1D6» with characteristics ×5…), import the story (scenario, scenes, places, characters, items, handouts) but put the printed stats only as text in the record (no 7e statblock), and say so at the top of your report.
- Records — book-scoped `<book_id>/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/<book_id>/<kinds>/`. Scenario record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, tomes, organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters of the book), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places. Cities — shared records (Р-190): Grep `kb/locations/` first (Arkham, Boston, London, New York, Cairo, Moscow?…) and never rewrite an existing one — add through proposals; a missing city where your scenario is set you create as a new shared record. Places outside a city — under «Окрестности <города>» (Р-209); a scenario without a named city gets a «город сценария» record (Р-190) inside its book. Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/<book-short>-<slug>.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206; check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209). New spells — draft them in your report (`kb/spells` is shared).
- `axes.era` — as printed (1920s, 1930s, modern…), `ruleset` "core" ("pulp" only if the book is written for Pulp Cthulhu). Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35); metric units (Р-64).
- Keep scratch files in your own scratchpad subfolder named after your unit.
- Coverage: `checks/20261112-owner-books/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.
